claim: To replace an unrolled POP/PUSH screen copy by zxnDMA exactly, DMA the rows, then jump into the original's last row with only its pointer registers set: it re-copies 32 bytes and leaves every register and self-modified byte as before.
limit: Gain only at 28 MHz and for long copies (per-row programs of 8 bytes by OTIR); 4,096 bytes saved ~17 model lines a view. A perturbation probe must show which registers matter at the entry point.

evidence.text: view copy DC37 (4,096 bytes, SP copy) by a 1,031-byte DMA program, then JP DE07 with HL 8FE0 / H'L' 4FEF, DE49 = 1, DE4F = SP, DC41 at SP - 2: copy_case equal to the original on registers and 128K
evidence.quote: then the original's last row from DE07

next_check: A test can perturb each register at the chosen entry and compare the end state (only pointers may matter).
